name: ubon
description: Checks what coding agents change and run: leaked secrets, trust-boundary bugs, missing data access policies, risky packages and commands, and weakened tests. Deterministic and local.

stop.title: Stop gate
stop.description: block: the agent must fix blocking findings before it finishes. warn: it is told about them and may stop. A session.stop value in the project's ubon.json takes precedence.

online.title: Registry lookups for installs
online.description: Check packages in install commands against the npm registry and OSV (existence, age, malicious-package records). Sends package names only. A packages.online value in the project's ubon.json takes precedence.
